address: Langton Studios, 35a High Street, Rainham, Kent,ME8 7HS
bio: Discover the distinctive charm of Café Nucleus Rainham, a haven for indulgent experiences on the scenic streets of Kent. Unparalleled in its offerings, this location promises a royal Afternoon Tea adventure within the picturesque surroundings of the Nucleus Arts Centre. With a touch of nostalgia and a dash of sophistication, Café Nucleus Rainham stands as a testament to exquisite dining and unwinding in a setting reminiscent of a bygone era.  Immerse yourself in the refined ambiance of Café Nucleus Rainham's Afternoon Tea experience, where the choice of venue is as delightful as the menu itself. The charming Parlour, located upstairs, invites guests to unwind amidst quirky decor, evoking a sense of a lost time. Alternatively, bask in the sophisticated atmosphere of the Wine Chamber, adorned with exquisite British hand-painted Jaguar wallpaper and housing nearly 2000 hand-selected bottles of exceptional wines and champagnes. Crisp white linen sets the scene, creating the perfect backdrop for an Afternoon Tea that transcends the ordinary.  Indulge in a sumptuous selection of finger sandwiches, featuring Dorset Coastal Cheddar with Homemade Caramelised Onions, Cucumber with Local Cream Cheese, Kentish Honey Roast Ham with Tracklements English Mustard, and John Ross Jr Aberdeen Scottish Smoked Salmon with Local Cream Cheese. Delight in a freshly baked fruited scone, adorned with Rodda’s Cornish Clotted Cream. Complete your journey with a tempting assortment of Afternoon Fancies, including handmade petit fours, truffles, and macarons from Bénodet, Brittany. Whether in the intimate Parlour or the exquisite Wine Chamber, Café Nucleus Rainham ensures a truly regal Afternoon Tea experience in the heart of Kent.
